st: Mystery Hum and Mayans on Mars
d: Examining whether a girl whose reflection doesn't match her expression is proof of a simulated reality; suggestion that Mars was colonized centuries ago; a mysterious hum being heard around the world.
A woman meets an unusual man in a diner; a trucker helps a mysterious colleague out of a storm, receiving a comforting message in return.
A woman claims to be tormented by apparitions; the story of a teen being attacked by a demonic beast; Rocky Primiani shares his story of encounters with the afterlife.
Chris Houston is haunted by an evil ghost boy; a farmhouse is cursed by the presence of dark entities; something dangerously demonic lurks in Bonnie Shukofsky's home.
The story of a woman who is followed by the evil spirit of a bootlegger; Felicia Sills finds a Civil War-era ring.
A man shares his story of a monster attack; a couple experience violent paranormal activity; Holly tells of being haunted by her ex-husband's ghost.
A woman's son is put in danger's way; a young boy is terrorized by a shadowy figure; Micky faces an evil spirit.

Visiting the chilling Iowa location of a gruesome ax murder with an adventurer, who experiences a haunting night he'll never forget; going for a regrettable walk through some sinister woods in the middle of England; exploring a haunted shop.

Explores the UK's most haunted house, 30 East Drive in Pontefract, where the demonic Black Monk is reported to linger; coming into contact with otherworldly beings who could finally prove that UFOs exist.

A Massachusetts sailor is shocked to his core when a sinister sound calls out at sea. In the UK, a lifelong paranormal believer reveals her collection of ghost pictures you need to see to believe. It's all unexplained and all caught on camera.

Every day, all around the world, in the most ordinary places, regular people are spotting UFOs; these witnesses will never see the night sky the same way, ever again.

When a person's day job involves the oversight of missile silos, nuclear facilities or a military base, the last complication they want to deal with is a close encounter with a UFO; here, an already frightening phenomenon turns positively chilling.
Closest encounters and first-hand experiences with abductions.
Aircraft pilots and passengers have a scary experience when they come into proximity to objects that don't appear on radar, accelerate at dizzying speeds and then stop on a dime.
UFO sightings are at an all-time high; from the lights that terrorized Phoenix to the disappearance of an object into the Atlantic Ocean, these events amaze and unsettle witnesses.
Visitations that leave behind objects or witnesses give us fascinating evidence.
